raw_html: [[Cannith Combat Infusion]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Cannith Combat Infusion]]:''' Your ranged and melee attacks have a chance to cause this item to inject a Cannith Combat Infusion into your bloodstream. For the next ten seconds, this will grant a +4 Alchemical bonus to Strength, Constitution and Dexterity, as well as a 5% Alchemical bonus to your chance to [[doublestrike]] and a +2 Alchemical bonus to [[Armor Class]].
